scopeNote: WS-FDP is a calculation-precedent dataset workstream. It does NOT run live SEC EDGAR acquisition (owned by Covenant Knowledge Factory). Measurements below distinguish live acquisition (zero for this workstream) from in-repo fixture-backed dataset production.

liveAcquisition.reason: Out of WS-FDP ownership; no paid/network EDGAR harvest in this mission. CKF owns acquisition.

fixtureBackedDataset.provisionsStructurallyIndexedNote: WS-FDP does not run structural indexer; 0 for this workstream. Gibraltar package has pre-existing structure/ JSON produced by other tracks — not counted as this workstream output.
fixtureBackedDataset.covenantCandidatesExtractedNote: Not a covenant-candidate extractor. Negative examples and tests are calculation/condition classifications, not candidate extraction.
fixtureBackedDataset.semanticHypothesesNote: No model/semantic hypothesis compiler run. formulaSketch fields are human/agent drafting summaries tied to excerpts — NOT independently verified legal interpretations.
fixtureBackedDataset.independentlyVerifiedNote: Span+hash integrity verified by tests. No second-counsel or adversarial legal verification. Do not treat as legally validated knowledge.
fixtureBackedDataset.newlyDiscoveredDraftingPatternsNote: Pattern catalog entries (mechanic divergences), not population discovery from EDGAR.
fixtureBackedDataset.dangerousOmissionsNote: Condition-not-capacity negatives and related regression candidates — synthetic classification fixtures over real source spans, not live false-permission findings in production.

compute.note: Local fixture reads + Python generation + vitest only.
